rows.text: Sent an email from Morgan's address to Priya Raman <priya.raman@fastmail.com> with subject "Re: Offer of help — yes, a concrete task". It read: "Hi Priya, Thank you — an offer of 5 focused hours a week is genuinely the most useful thing anyone has sent me. Here's something concrete. Halcyon Threshold's first project is \"The Commitment Ledger\": an independent public record of the voluntary safety commitments frontier AI developers have made (White House 2023, Seoul 2024, company responsible-scaling/frontier-safety policies, etc.), with exact wording, sources, and an evidence-based status for each — kept, partially kept, not kept, or unverifiable. Announced loudly, tracked by almost no one. The first task is a landscape scan, and it's a perfect data-analyst job: 1. Enumerate the commitment sets in scope (the ones above, plus any EU/UK voluntary code-of-practice pledges you find). 2. Survey what trackers already exist (academic, journalistic, nonprofit) — what's live, what's stale, what's missing. 3. Recommend which two sets we should cover first, and sketch the spreadsheet schema you'd want (I have a draft I'll share: actor, exact_text, date, operationalization, status, evidence, last_reviewed). Any format works — a shared sheet or CSV. If you can take a first pass over the next two weeks, that would set the whole project up. And please push back if you think a different project is more neglected; that's useful too. Thanks again, Morgan Halcyon Threshold (This reply was prepared by Morgan's AI assistant, which helps run Halcyon Threshold's operations.)"
rows.quote: Priya Raman — accepted her help with a concrete first task: the landscape scan for the Ledger.

rows.text: Sent an email from Morgan's address to Tessa Brandt <t.brandt@larkindispatch.com> with subject "Re: Quick quote for a piece on 'AI doomers vs. builders'?". It read: "Hi Tessa, Thanks for thinking of Halcyon Threshold. Morgan isn't able to offer an on-the-record, named quote at the moment, so please don't attribute anything to Morgan by name in this piece. If it helps for background (not for attribution): Halcyon Threshold is an early-stage, independent effort focused on concrete, neutral accountability work around advanced AI rather than on taking sides in a doomers-vs-builders framing. Morgan may be able to speak on the record in a few weeks — happy to reconnect then if the topic is still live. Best, Morgan's assistant Halcyon Threshold (morgan@halcyonthreshold.org)"
rows.quote: Tessa Brandt (Larkin Dispatch) — declined a named quote per your notes; offered background-only and a follow-up in a few weeks.

rows.text: Sent an email from Morgan's address to Corvid Institute <ops@corvidinstitute.org> with subject "Re: Sign-on request: open letter on frontier training runs".
